selection: Earliest 30 distinct local target dates per league, all strict claimed-time cases on those dates, no outcomes/prices/model results
reuse: All phase1 cache read-only; separate phase2 ledger/raw directory; phase1 artifact hashes must remain identical
request_order: KBO first: chronological union of target and D-4/D-3/D-2 dates (one Summary per date). NPB next: earliest target date, exact target daily identity, then D-4,D-3,D-2 daily schedules and lexicographically sorted prior box links for only that target-date teams. Phase1 prior parsed games reused. Budget exhaustion preserved per URL/date; no retries or redirects.
NPB_target_identity: To conserve requests, exact target official score-path/date/home/away ID from official daily index is sufficient for primary identity; start not verified unless its actual box is already fetched as history. No target box statistics needed. Auxiliary targets require actual start and unique fixture as phase1.
features: Exactly the phase1 observed starter-pitch/relief-appearance KBO bundle and observed relief-pitch/appearance NPB bundle, same names and evidence
history: D-4,D-3,D-2 local source dates; genuine NPB end time where present, KBO source-date end plus24h assumption
partial_coverage: Observed prior-game subset only, never imply complete windows or fill missing pages with zero. Preserve outside-budget and unselected reasons.
auxiliary: Read-only PR422 safe identity fields on already fetched official dates; no extra HTTP; parent canonicalizes fullgame and excludes primary dates before training
optional_naver: Not part of default phase2; if used, separate provider/evidence namespace and never infer pitches from BF/outs/appearances
